The name Altamis carries the meaning “Noble, Sublime” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Altamis usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, sublime and live with faith, good character and purpose.

He was one of the ten pledges of 'Aqaba, a significant event in Islamic history where a group of Arabian leaders pledged their allegiance to the Prophet and accepted Islam. The event took place in 624 AD, marking a turning point in the early Muslim community's transition from a small, marginalized community to a formidable political force.
